symptom: A synthetic empty Map.prototype.values iterator can make a populated reconciliation Map produce zero ordered records and PASS with sourceRows > 0 and mappedUnique 0. Ambient Map.prototype.get/set can also suppress same-identity duplicate and conflict detection. Node 22.16.0 source-equivalent reproduction confirmed the values() membership erasure. No private rows, external evidence or production execution were involved.
lesson: An own-descriptor source-row loop still cannot guarantee reconciliation completeness if accepted records are later enumerated through mutable Map.prototype.values, or duplicate/conflict lookup uses mutable Map.prototype.get/set. A nonempty source with PASS and zero mapped membership is an audit failure, not successful evidence.
guardrail: Keep accepted mapped records in an indexed own-data array and same-identity lookups in a null-prototype own-descriptor dictionary. Do not depend on ambient Map.prototype.get/set/values for reconciliation membership. Regress reordered accepted rows, exact duplicates, changed same-identity conflicts and stable digest under reversible no-op Map hooks; never infer source authenticity or production authority.
